description: An open tab loads a full page instead of SPA navigation once the server names another runtime build, recovers from a missing runtime with one reload, and never reloads in a loop

browserSteps.value: Baseline: with the same runtime build on both sides, navigation stays in the SPA
if (window.__spaMarker !== true) { throw new Error('the navigation loaded a full page although the runtime did not change'); }
Version switch: the server now names another runtime build, so the next navigation is a full load
if (window.__spaMarker === true) { throw new Error('a fragment from another runtime build was morphed into this tab'); }
One runtime runs after the full load, and the page script binds its button once

const loads = performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(entry => /^\/_piko\/dist\/[0-9a-f]{16}\/ppframework\.core\.es\.js$/.test(new URL(entry.name).pathname)); if (loads.length !== 1) { throw new Error('expected the page to load one runtime, got ' + loads.length); } const running = window.__pikoRuntime; if (!running || !running.version || !loads[0].name.includes('/' + running.version + '/')) { throw new Error('the running runtime is not the one this page loaded'); }
While the server keeps naming another build, every navigation stays a full load
